description: Find a work email by first name, last name and company domain, via LeadMagic. Every email returned is already SMTP/deliverability-validated on LeadMagic's side; a confirmed no-match is free (0 credits). Example: leadmagic_find_email({ first_name: "Patrick", last_name: "Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-leadmagic-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your LeadMagic API key (get one at leadmagic.io).
